title: SALAAMI SUVEY MAQTAL SYED-E-ABRAAR AATHAY HAIN
body:
SALAAMI SUVEY MAQTAL SYED-E-ABRAAR AATHAY HAIN
HATHAILEE PAR DHAREY SAR KHALQ KE SARDAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
HAMAAREY KHWAAB MAI JAB SYED-E-ABRAAR AATHAY HAIN
MUBAARAK BAAD DENAY TAALA-E-BEYDAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
JIGAR MAI DARD LAB PAR AAH AANSOO DONO AANKHOUN MAI
BADAY SAAMAAN SEY HAZRATH KE MAATAMDAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
KHAYAAL SHAH-E-WAALA MAI DIL-E-MUZTAR YEH KEHTHA HAI
UTT AEY DARD-E-JIGAR TAAZEEM KO SARKAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
SAWAARI HAI YEH AKBAR KI KAY QUDRATH KA NAMOONA HAI
SHABAAHATH KEH RAHI HAI AHMAD-E-MUKHTAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
BADAY FAIYAAZ HAIN YEH RONAY WAALEY BHI KE MAJLIS MAI
JAB AATHAY HAIN LUTAANEY GOWHAR-E-SHEHWAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ABHI KHAIMEY SE NIKLEY BHI NA THAY GHUL MACHGAYAA RUN MAI
ALAMBARDAAR AATHAY HAIN ALAMBARDAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
ANDHERI RAAT MAI BANU YEHI KEH-KEH KE ROTHI THI
KAY AKBAR YAAD TERAY CHAAND SEY RUKHSAAR AATHAY HAIN
<<DIVIDER>>
GADHAA HOON MAI DAREY SHEH KA YEH SUNTHA HOON KE AYE ASIF
MERAY SARTAAJ RAKHNEY KO MERAY SARKAAR AATHAY HAIN.
